title: Todo app sample
_comment: The sample demo made with demo-studio: a public todo app (TodoMVC, React), three scenes, built to docs/quality-bar.md. Times in callouts/zooms/highlights are seconds into the scene after trim and speed; crop, focus and rect are source px of the 1920x1080 take. The three scenes form one window run, so the window rises once and the clips cut inside it.

sequence.title: A todo list in three moves.
sequence.subtitle: Recorded and cut with demo-studio.
sequence.voiceover: A todo list should take seconds. Type what needs doing, press Enter, and it lands in the list.
Tick things off as you finish them. The filters show what is still active, and what is already done.
Then clear the finished ones in one click, and the list is clean again.

sequence.title: Real app. Real clicks.
sequence.subtitle: github.com/Cyvid7-Darus10/demo-studio
